stages.choice_rule: Four unique kid sentences of four to ten words. Exactly one uses the headword with the meaning in the stem entry. For a homograph, one distractor uses the other common meaning. Remaining distractors are unrelated kid-world sentences, plus one lookalike word at tier 3. Words from the roots wordlist and allowed_extra_words only. No brands, no real names, no picture talk. Do not copy the stem gloss into a choice.

choices: The puppy sat on the bed.
The plant grew in the sun.

gold_items.stem: kite: a toy in the sky
choices: The frog sat on a log.

choices: A boat is on the lake.

roots: Keep the stem as a short dictionary entry: headword, then a gloss. At tier 3 add a part-of-speech label before the gloss.
Exactly one choice sentence uses the headword with that gloss. Never write two sentences that both fit.
When the headword has two common kid meanings, one distractor must use the other meaning.
Other distractors must not reuse the gloss words as a giveaway and must stay in school, home, food, pets, play, family, or weather.
At tier 3 add one near-miss lookalike word in a distractor, such as watch and wash or light and night.
Never name a brand, a real person, or a picture. Use <NAME> for people.

tier_rules.1: Short entry of three to five words and one clear kid meaning. Distractor sentences are about other things, not a second meaning. Add a lemma picture for a concrete noun.
tier_rules.2: Homograph entries of five to seven words. One distractor uses the other common meaning. Two-syllable kid words are fine.
tier_rules.3: Near-miss entries that include a part-of-speech label. Distractors include the other meaning and a lookalike word. Still one tap and one right sentence.

match_entry.en: Pick the sentence that uses the word the same way as the entry.
match_entry.ko: 뜻풀이와 같은 뜻으로 단어를 쓴 문장을 고르세요.

other_sense.en: This word has more than one meaning. Match this entry.
other_sense.ko: 이 단어는 뜻이 여러 개입니다. 이 뜻풀이에 맞는 문장을 고르세요.

wrong_word.en: That sentence does not use the meaning in the entry.
wrong_word.ko: 그 문장은 이 뜻풀이의 뜻을 쓰지 않습니다.
